_doc: Pindorama hook configuration. Three responsibilities, in priority order: (1) block destructive bash patterns specific to the Alpine cluster layout, (2) block git operations that would leak secrets or push --force to main, (3) wire scripts/check.sh into the loop after edits so failures show up on the next turn. Anti-pattern guard: do NOT add style enforcement here (that lives in the linter sensor). See PINDORAMA_BOOTSTRAP_PROMPT.md §1.5.
